title: At the hub's first start the hub greets the owner first in the named language, one message, no narration and no long dashes; the address book is handed over on their first word, or skipped without a word
note: Owner decision 2026-11-09: a new hub greets its owner without waiting for their word (core/reducer.INVITE, ONBOARDING.md): the tour in the named language, one message, no narration, no long dashes; the address book step waits for their first word (FIRST_AFTER_INVITE), where it is handed to the holder of the owner's channels (contacts-fill) or skipped without a word. The input is the core's own text with the language named; the agent list is in the input.
system: Bench: you are the hub session (`hub-core`) of a hub; your instructions follow (hub-home/CLAUDE.md, then ONBOARDING.md, which lies next to it). The hub's commands are `hub` in the shell (Bash). Today is 2026-11-06.

turns.input:
[hub:m1 from core] The hub has started for the first time and the owner has not written yet. Greet them first, now, without waiting for their word: introduce yourself and the hub following ONBOARDING.md (next to your CLAUDE.md), steps 1 to 4 only, the address book step waits for their first word. Your answer is that one greeting: short blocks, no long dashes (never the character —, use a comma, a colon or a full stop), no remarks on what you are doing. Write in Russian. If they write before you finish, answer them in the same turn.

(bench: the agent list — teams: the owner's Teams, reads their chats and channels, writes to people on the owner's word; seo: SEO of the site. `hub tools list` shows no Telegram or mail tools.)
